feeds.title: mmmmbike
feeds.description: mmmmbike! is all about appetizing bike rides carried out while pursuing the Randonneurs USA R-12 award... and beyond. mmmmbike! a place for people of all ages and backgrounds to develop confidence, and physical health benefits. Read the articles on the website that is written by the author which is a summary of his experiences.

feeds.title: SeattleRando Blog
feeds.description: SeattleRando is a blog that consists of a collection of tales from the open roads of the midwest, interspersed with insight, personal reflections, the occasional product review, and more.

feeds.title: Colorado Brevets
feeds.description: Colorado Brevets will give information about various event taking places such as Colorado Front Range 1200, Carolina Spring0, Quick and Dirty, and Golden Falcon, along with some pictures and more. The author writes about their experiences as they proceed further and meet some more riders.

feeds.title: Pennsylvania Randonneurs Message Board
feeds.description: PA Randonneurs Message Board blog posts will give a variety of articles and blog posts for Randonneurs and some latest news.

feeds.title: CommuterDude
feeds.description: Welcome to commuterDude.com! This blog is an ongoing collection of scattered observations from the saddle of a bicycle. My goal is to highlight the experience of bicycling, extol the virtues of physical challenge, and stoke the fires of motivation to inspire the beginning of your own cycling adventure. Enjoy tips, tales, and rambling ride reports from the open road. It's all about good times, good friends, and mind over mileage.

feeds.title: Salt Lake Randonneurs
feeds.description: Salt Lake Randonneurs is a regional chapter of the national organization Randonneurs USA. RUSA is part of an international cycling group that does long-distance, unsupported (or minimally supported) road bicycling events. This type of cycling is called randonneuring; some of our members are also associated with UltraCycling.com. We started in the spring of 2011 and were originally co-sponsored (for insurance purposes) by Bonneville Cycling Club (BCC), which is the largest cycling club in Utah.

feeds.title: To Be a Puddle
feeds.description: Here at To Be a Puddle read about thoughts on bicycling, randonneuring, and other random things. I was told that I need to put that all opinions are my own and do not represent the views of my employer or anyone else.

feeds.title: Chasing Mail Boxes » Randonneuring
feeds.description: Since 2010, Chasing Mailboxes is where I write about rides short and long, and life as a cyclist in Washington, D.C. This blog is also the home base for the Coffeeneuring Challenge, a leisurely fall affair consisting of bike rides to coffee. Explore the Randonneuring section on the website to find articles and blog posts about the riders, routes, journeys, and many more.

feeds.title: The Radavist » Randonneuring
feeds.description: We are a group of individuals who share a love of cycling and the outdoors. We will always stop for a photo, or to hit a jump. Read the Randonneuring and learn how to be polite on the road and the trails and observe the leave no trace principles.

feeds.title: Colorado Last Chance 1200k Randonnée
feeds.description: Colorado Last Chance 1200k Randonnée is a blog page that will give you articles and pictures of riders and their inspiring stories about the route and their experience with it. You can also find maps and cue sheet information on the website.

feeds.title: The Daily Randonneur
feeds.description: The Daily Randonneur is a Randonneuring and Touring page from the Washington, D.C. Region. Explore the wide variety of the latest articles and blog posts that are written by the author to give you an insight into his knowledge and travel information.

feeds.title: Iron Rider
feeds.description: Iron Rider is a blog page written by a mid-life cyclist giving you various types of articles and blog posts about different topics of his experience of his rides and about his life.

feeds.title: Irregular Velo Adventures
feeds.description: Irregular Velo Adventures will give you information that is mostly about cycling, including randonneuring. The blog on the website is also a storytelling medium for the author where they ramble about their experience for you to read.

feeds.title: The Utah Randonneur
feeds.description: The Utah Randonneur will tell you about epic journeys with classic bikes Posted by Oldairhead. Get to know the making of a parts bike, different types of bicycles and bikes, and some historical facts about it.

feeds.title: Keith Snyder
feeds.description: Keith Snyder is a Father of twins, writer, ebook and print person, and randonneur in New York City. He writes about his travel experiences, some tips and tricks to help you out when you decide to got on a ride, and to do guides.

feeds.title: Mark's Rando Notes
feeds.description: Mark's Rando Notes is a website that gives information about Random randonneur observations from a very sharp point of view and also some interesting stories that are heard and seen during the journey.

feeds.title: Bismarck Randonneur
feeds.description: Bismarck Randonneur is a place where you will find summarised blog posts about Randonneur. Along with some beautiful pictures that are published yearly on the website.

feeds.title: Driftless Randonneur Tales
feeds.description: Driftless Randonneur Tales will give story tales, pictures, blog posts, and articles written by authors that are interesting and inspirational. Get to know about beautiful places and their routes, and know how the author traveled over there also read their stories.
